assessment.summary: Evaluation of video_1.mp4 against the AgentFilm contract. The video follows the editorial visual design, typography layout, asset positioning, and core narrative flow well. However, during the crowding sequence in Beat 2, the opening headline fails to translate upward or scale down as incoming questions enter.

observations.description: Opens on cream background (#FFFCEE) with the logo positioned at x=48, y=112 (width 128). The headline 'A trip worth\nremembering.' smoothly settles upward to x=56, y=350 with a short yellow underline under 'remembering'.

Four editorial questions enter at staggered intervals ('Which flight?', 'Where to stay?', 'What to do?', 'Getting around?'). At ~4250ms, 'So much to arrange.' appears centrally. The opening text 'A trip worth remembering.' stays fixed at its initial position and scale until ~4250ms, when it fades out abruptly.

The crowded composition holds still from 6400ms to 6800ms before questions move outward offscreen and 'So much to arrange.' fades away. The mascot ascends to x=180, y=826 (width 360) with arms extended. At 7800ms, cuts to reveal the trip_plan crop with headline 'One trip.\nIn view.'.

Stationary hold on the crop of trip_plan (x=48, y=410, width 624) displaying UAE, Dubai trip sections (Stays, Flights, Activities, Car Rentals). Headline 'One trip.\nIn view.' sits at x=56, y=216. Logo and mascot remain motionless in their respective positions.
Headline transitions via opacity dissolve to 'Now picture\nbeing there.' at x=56, y=216. All other elements (trip_plan crop, logo, mascot) remain flat, sharp, and stationary.

Over 16400ms to 17000ms, headline clears, logo animates to center top (y=160, width 260), mascot repositions to x=210, y=786 (width 300), and a yellow editorial banner appears at x=48, y=984 with dark text 'Create your trip.'. Layout holds until 20000ms.

checks.reason: The final stage resolves smoothly into the centered logo, resized mascot, and yellow callout band 'Create your trip.' held through frame 20.0s.
